description:
Say now what should happen if you win.

Decided BEFORE the round, deliberately. Asking in the moment is asking
somebody to make a decision about money with a trophy on the screen, and a
winner who has never thought about it should still end the round with their
share settled rather than owed.

Donating is the default. Keeping it needs somewhere to send it, so a patron
who turns donation off without giving an address is told so rather than
quietly left with an unclaimable prize.

donate.description: Give your winnings to the charity. True by default.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

lightning_address.description: Where to send your share if you are keeping it.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

name: beesknees_set_payout
title: Set my payout choice
